messages:
Maya K: Heads-up — Alpine Capital just sent their security questionnaire and a follow-up asking for an evidence bundle: on‑prem HSM KMS envelope flow, RBAC change history for service accounts, and audit-log retention proof. They want to confirm we can provide chain-of-custody for keys and log exports for an incident drill.
Raj P: ok, concrete asks?
Maya K: They listed three items: 1) KMS key provenance + HSM signing proof, 2) RBAC change audit (who changed roles + diff), 3) tamper-evident audit log export for a 90‑day window (plus retention policy). Also asked if we support PS‑level SIEM ingest of raw logs.
Lindsey S: for (1) we can provide the envelope metadata + KMS key creation entries from KMS audit logs and the HSM attestation statement. Need to confirm with infra if attestation artefacts are stored for on‑prem pilot.
Samir G: For (2) we have the RBAC change events in vault-authz and in the central audit-log. It contains a timestamp, actor, and change payload. We do not currently ship a human‑readable "diff" by default but can generate one from the change events.
Raj P: For (3) our audit retention policy is 1 year in hot storage, 7 years in cold archival per enterprise plan. But important: the on‑prem option currently exposes logs to the customer's SIEM endpoint — we need to clarify which deployment mode Alpine is on.
Maya K: They're on Dedicated with a pilot for Private (VPC + on‑prem HSM). They explicitly asked for a signed bundle that shows logs were not tampered with during handoff.
Lindsey S: OK we should offer a reproducible export: 
- step 1: snapshot audit index for the requested window 
- step 2: sign the snapshot manifest with our signing key (HSM attestation included) 
- step 3: provide the chain (manifest, chunk hashes, signature) + instructions to verify locally.
Samir G: I'll draft a script to generate the manifest and sign using the HSM test key. Will need ops to approve use of the attestation cert for customer deliveries.
Maya K: Also Alpine asked about RBAC rollback proofs — i.e., if we revert a role change, they want an auditable trace that shows the rollback sequence and justification.
Raj P: We have justification notes stored in ticket metadata but not normalized into the audit log. Quick solution: attach ticket ID to the RBAC event export and include ticket thread (redacted) in the bundle. Longer term we should add an "actor_reason" field to RBAC events.
Lindsey S: Vulnerability note: while preparing exports, we found a flaky agent that occasionally drops the actor field on role changes (internal bug, low occ). Filed GH-3721, severity medium, assigned to @samir. This could affect completeness of historical audits.
Samir G: Confirmed GH-3721. Working on a fix; mitigation: backfill from service logs where possible and mark affected windows in the evidence manifest.
sec-bot: New runbook created: https://internal/runbooks/eng-security/alpine-evidence-bundle (created by Maya K) :file_folder:
Maya K: Next steps: (a) Samir will produce a POC signed snapshot for the 2026-02-01..2026-03-01 window, (b) Lindsey will coordinate attestation cert release with infra, (c) Raj will prepare RBAC change export + ticket links. We should aim to deliver initial bundle by EOD Thursday.
Raj P: I'll also confirm whether we can push a one-time SIEM raw log export to Alpine's collector (they requested syslog over TLS). Need SOC approval.
Lindsey S: SOC ok pending redaction checklist. We'll need to redact tenant IDs for other customers before export.
Samir G: Drafted manifest script in branch: gitlab.com/redwood/sec-evidence/alpine-proofs, making PR now.
Maya K: Thanks — I'll reply to Alpine to set expectations and request the exact window and their SIEM endpoint cert if they want direct push. :thumbsup:
